configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: The documented AGENTS.md configure: VS 2022 x64, Qt 6.8.3, /W3, no sanitizer.

configurePresets.name: w4
configurePresets.description: Warning burn-down build: first-party targets at /W4 /permissive-, vendor sources at /W3, <...> and vendor/ headers external at /external:W0. No /WX.

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: /fsanitize=address /Zi, /INCREMENTAL:NO, built RelWithDebInfo (no /RTC). Qt-free: the UI and its tests are off; build and test the core/engine/sdk/backend labels.

testPresets.name: asan
testPresets.description: The Qt-free labels under ASan. CMake prepends the ASan runtime directory (the one cl.exe is in) to every test's PATH through ENVIRONMENT_MODIFICATION: a preset cannot discover the MSVC toolset directory itself.
